summary_md: **Spencer ([@spencer_clark](https://x.com/spencer_clark/status/2116595560442388965))** writes in *Back to School* that prompting could not teach Qwen3.5-9B to escape his maze game, but fine-tuning a model half its size on a gaming GPU did, with a single word nearly derailing it ([Maze Escape blog](https://spencerclark.dev/blog/maze-escape/), [spenceclark/maze-agent](https://github.com/spenceclark/maze-agent)).

referenced_urls.title: Maze Escape: can LLM agents cooperate to find the exit?

relevance: Fine-tuning small local models for agent reasoning.
